fields.summary_ko.0: AVGO (current price $326.08) declined 12.74% over the past year, but Q3 earnings increased 85.5% year-over-year, presenting a valuation opportunity due to supply bottleneck.
fields.summary_ko.1: CEO Hock Tan provided AI semiconductor outlook of approximately $11.5B for 2027 and $23B for 2028, though actual demand appears to exceed this; Q3 AI semiconductor revenue of $1.67B up 221% year-over-year, with Q4 expected at $2.17B (up 236%).
fields.summary_ko.2: Q3 non-GAAP EPS of $3.32 exceeded estimate of $3.2382 for ninth consecutive beat; free cash flow of $13.665B represents 46% of earnings, with dividend raised for 15 consecutive years and current yield approximately 0.8%.
